The optional tutorial for new characters, played in a cave of crystals and lava beneath {wiki:Dawnport|Dawnport}. You learn to walk, pick up items, attack, loot, eat and talk to NPCs, and at the end you are teleported to Dawnport with a {item:Backpack}, a {item:Rope}, a {item:Torch} and 3 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.
